title: ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος καὶ τὰ κακὰ ζῷα
learning_goal: Practice emotions φοβέομαι and χαίρω with repeated patterns, plus movement verbs ἔρχομαι and φέρω, emphasizing the cycle of fear and relief through repetition.
plot: Four animal friends play ball outside, but scary creatures keep appearing one by one; each time Hyperbrephos arrives to drag the troublemaker away, allowing the friends to resume their happy game.

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος καὶ ἡ Πάνδα καὶ ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ἡ Γλαὺξ παίζουσι τῇ σφαίρᾳ παρὰ τὴν οἰκίαν.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Dinosaur stands in the center tossing the ball upward with a happy smile
Panda sits on the ground to the left, clapping his paws cheerfully
Koala stands to the right with her arms outstretched to catch the ball
Glaux perches on a low garden fence post with wings spread in joy
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit is in the air above Dinosaur

frames.text: οἴμοι! ὁ κόραξ ἔρχεται. τὰ ζῷα φοβεῖται.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Korax swoops down from above with his wings spread wide, looking menacing and angry
Dinosaur drops his arms and looks up with wide, frightened eyes
Panda stops clapping and cowers backward with a scared expression
Koala takes a step back toward the house with her paws raised defensively
Glaux flutters nervously on her perch
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit falls to the ground forgotten

objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Hyperbrephos crawls into view from the edge of the frame with determination, approaching Korax
Korax looks startled and nervous as he notices the approaching super-baby
The four animal friends watch with growing hope as their protector arrives
Dinosaur, Panda, Koala, and Glaux all turn their attention to Hyperbrephos with relief beginning to show
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit lies forgotten on the ground

frames.text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος φέρει τὸν κόρακα ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Hyperbrephos drags Korax by the wing toward the edge of the frame
Korax is being pulled along reluctantly, squawking and looking annoyed
The four animal friends watch with relief as the troublemaker is removed
Dinosaur, Panda, Koala, and Glaux all have hopeful expressions returning to their faces
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit lies on the ground nearby

frames.text: τὰ ζῷα χαίρει καὶ πάλιν παίζει τῇ σφαίρᾳ.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Dinosaur picks up the ball again with a cheerful smile
Panda claps his paws happily while sitting
Koala stretches her arms out ready to play
Glaux perches contentedly on the fence post
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit is in Dinosaur's hands

frames.text: οἴμοι! ὁ Λύκος ἔρχεται. τὰ ζῷα φοβεῖται πάλιν.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Lukos emerges from behind the shade tree with his yellow eyes gleaming menacingly and his tattered cloak flowing
Dinosaur freezes with the ball in his hands, eyes wide with fear
Panda scrambles backward on all fours looking terrified
Koala steps back toward the house with a frightened expression
Glaux ruffles her feathers in alarm
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit is clutched tightly in Dinosaur's scared grip

objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Hyperbrephos crawls into the scene with confidence, heading straight toward Lukos
Lukos looks around nervously as he spots the approaching super-baby
The four friends begin to show signs of relief as they see their hero approaching
All four animals watch with anticipation as help arrives
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit remains clutched in Dinosaur's grip

frames.text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος φέρει τὸν Λύκον ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Hyperbrephos drags Lukos by his tattered cloak toward the edge of the scene
Lukos is being pulled along with his paws dragging in the dirt, looking defeated and embarrassed
The four friends watch with growing relief as their protector handles the situation
All four animals begin to smile again as safety returns
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit remains in Dinosaur's loosening grip

frames.text: τὰ ζῷα χαίρει καὶ πάλιν παίζει τῇ σφαίρᾳ.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Dinosaur tosses the ball up in the air with renewed joy
Panda claps enthusiastically from his seated position
Koala reaches up with both paws to catch the ball, smiling widely
Glaux spreads her wings in celebration on her perch
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit soars through the air between the friends

frames.text: οἴμοι! ὁ ὄφις ἔρχεται. τὰ ζῷα φοβεῖται πάλιν.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Ophis slithers into view from the bottom corner of the frame, his dark-olive scales gleaming and golden eyes half-lidded with menace
Dinosaur drops his arms and steps back with alarm
Panda stops clapping and looks down nervously at the approaching serpent
Koala takes a defensive step backward
Glaux flutters her wings anxiously on her perch
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit falls toward the ground again

objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Hyperbrephos crawls forward decisively, approaching the slithering serpent
Ophis notices the super-baby's approach and looks wary
The animal friends watch with familiar relief as their protector comes to save them again
Dinosaur, Panda, Koala, and Glaux all show hopeful expressions
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit lies on the ground near the action

frames.text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος φέρει τὸν ὄφιν ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Hyperbrephos drags Ophis by the tail toward the edge of the frame
Ophis is being pulled along in reluctant S-curves, his forked tongue flicking in annoyance
The animal friends watch with familiar relief as their hero saves the day once more
Dinosaur, Panda, Koala, and Glaux all show grateful expressions
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit sits on the ground waiting to be retrieved

frames.text: τὰ ζῷα χαίρει καὶ πάλιν παίζει τῇ σφαίρᾳ.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Dinosaur bends down to pick up the ball with a relieved smile
Panda resumes his cheerful clapping
Koala gets ready to catch the ball again
Glaux settles comfortably on her fence post perch
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit is being lifted by Dinosaur's hands

frames.text: οἴμοι! ὁ ἀλώπηξ ἔρχεται. τὰ ζῷα φοβεῖται πάλιν.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Alopex creeps into view with his narrow silhouette, rust-orange fur, and sly grin, his patched chiton and worn cloak making him look suspicious
Dinosaur clutches the ball protectively with worried eyes
Panda cowers low to the ground with fear
Koala backs toward the house once more
Glaux ruffles her feathers and leans away from the fox
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit is held tight against Dinosaur's chest

objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Hyperbrephos crawls forward with authority, heading toward the sly fox
Alopex's sly grin fades as he realizes he's been spotted by the super-baby
The four friends watch with deep relief and anticipation as their hero approaches
All animals show expressions of thankfulness as help arrives once more
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit remains safely in Dinosaur's protective grip

frames.text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος φέρει τὸν ἀλώπηκα ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Hyperbrephos drags Alopex by his worn traveler's cloak toward the frame's edge
Alopex is being pulled along with his paws sliding in the dirt, his sly grin replaced by embarrassment
The four friends watch with deep relief and gratitude as peace is restored once again
All animals show expressions of thankfulness toward their mighty protector
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit remains safely in Dinosaur's protective grip

frames.text: τὰ ζῷα χαίρει καὶ πάλιν παίζει τῇ σφαίρᾳ. νῦν οὐ φοβεῖται.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Dinosaur throws the ball high into the air with the biggest smile yet, completely relaxed
Panda claps joyfully while laughing with pure happiness
Koala jumps up with both paws reaching for the ball, grinning widely
Glaux spreads her wings in triumph and celebration on her perch
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit flies high above them all in a perfect arc
